item.title: Toyota RAV4 vs Ford Kuga in Europe: The Cost of Opportunity Most Buyers Ignore
item.description:
When comparing cars for personal use, most buyers focus on standard metrics: fuel consumption, reliability, comfort, and resale value.

However, very few consider a much more impactful financial metric:

The opportunity cost of the capital tied up in the purchase price.

item.title: How I Ended Up Choosing the Ford Kuga Over the RAV4 in Romania And Why It Was the Best Value SUV
item.description: After 160+ hours of research, during which Japanese brands consistently topped the list, I unexpectedly chose an American SUV: the Ford Kuga. Here’s how it outclassed the competition, including the beloved Toyota RAV4, in the Romanian market.
